frame.intro: Your answer helps us improve. It takes 10 seconds.
frame.title: Quick question
ideas.blocker_share: {blocker} almost stopped {percent}% of buyers. It's likely stopping others who didn't order.
ideas.channel_share: Most buyers find you through {channel}. Consider whether your spend there matches its share.
ideas.delivery_fast: Many buyers expect delivery within 2 days. Showing clear delivery dates on product pages can set expectations.
ideas.delivery_unsure: About {percent}% of buyers aren't sure they'll be available. Checking these orders before dispatch may avoid failed deliveries.
ideas.fit_unsure: Buyers often feel unsure about {product}'s fit. A clearer size guide or fit photos may help.
ideas.no_ad_recall: Most buyers don't remember your ads. Word of mouth or search may be doing more of the work.
ideas.nps_detractors: 1 in 5 returning buyers wouldn't recommend you. Their comments on what to fix are in Responses.
ideas.nudge_count: Most new buyers needed several touches. One ad or post alone may not show its full effect.
ideas.price_high: {product} feels pricey to many buyers. A bundle or a free-shipping threshold may help.
ideas.slow_decision: Many buyers take weeks to decide. Reminders and retargeting may matter for you.
ideas.switch_price: Price is the main reason buyers switch. Watch how price changes affect new buyers.
ideas.trust_top: {answer} builds the most trust. Consider making it easy to see on product pages.
ideas.videos_matter: Buyers value videos. Products without videos may be missing out.
packs.profile_fashion_question: Which style feels most like you?
packs.profile_home_question: Which room are you shopping for?

tags.ad_recall.tip: Shows which of your ads and messages buyers remember.
tags.after_delivery.tip: Collects feedback once the order has arrived.
tags.best_channels.tip: Shows which channels your buyers mention most, with their revenue.
tags.brand_presence.tip: Shows the channels where buyers keep seeing your brand, not only where they first found it.
tags.business_buyers.tip: Flags orders from businesses or group buyers.
tags.buyer_values.tip: Shows what buyers care about, like eco-friendly packaging.
tags.checkout_blockers.tip: Shows what almost stopped buyers from ordering.
tags.contact_channels.tip: Shows which channels buyers want to hear from you on, and how many want nothing.
tags.content_wishes: Learns what buyers want to hear
tags.content_wishes.tip: Shows which updates buyers want from you.
tags.delivery_expectations.tip: Shows how fast buyers expect their order.
tags.delivery_risk.tip: Flags orders where the buyer may not be available to receive them.
tags.discount_reliance.tip: Shows how many buyers needed a discount to buy, and how many would have bought anyway.
tags.fit_doubts.tip: Flags orders where the buyer isn't sure about size or fit.
tags.gift_buyers.tip: Shows which orders are gifts and for which occasion.
tags.loyalty.tip: Tracks your Net Promoter Score over time.
tags.missing_products.tip: Collects products buyers looked for but didn't find.
tags.nudge_count.tip: Shows how many times buyers saw you before ordering.
tags.open_feedback.tip: Collects what buyers want to tell you in their own words.
tags.other_stores.tip: Shows which marketplaces, stores and brands your buyers also buy from.
tags.page_convincers.tip: Shows which parts of your product page helped most.
tags.page_gaps.tip: Collects what buyers missed on your product pages.
tags.price_feel.tip: Shows whether buyers felt your prices were fair.
tags.product_discovery.tip: Shows whether buyers reach products through search, menus, recommendations or links.
tags.profiles.tip: Saves answers like skin type or style to the customer.
tags.purchase_triggers.tip: Shows the last thing that sent each buyer to your store, so you can see which channel closes sales.
tags.reorder_timing.tip: Collects when buyers expect to run out.
tags.repeat_intent.tip: Shows how likely first-time buyers are to order again.
tags.return_reasons.tip: Shows what brings repeat buyers back.
tags.rival_names.tip: Collects the brands buyers compared you with.
tags.subscription_interest.tip: Shows how many buyers want automatic deliveries, and how often they want them.
tags.switch_reasons.tip: Shows what buyers used before and why they moved to you.
tags.time_to_buy.tip: Shows how long buyers knew about you before ordering.
tags.trust_builders.tip: Shows what made buyers comfortable ordering.
tags.unhappy_buyers.tip: Highlights low scores so you can follow up.
templates.ad-recall.good_to_know: Remove options for channels you don't use, so the list stays honest.
templates.ad-recall.learn_2: Whether buyers remember any ads at all.
templates.ad-recall.name: Which ad do you remember?
templates.ad-recall.one_liner: Ask which of your ads or messages buyers remember seeing.
templates.ad-recall.q_ads.text: Which of these have you seen from us recently?
templates.after-delivery.good_to_know: Paste the survey link into your own email or SMS a few days after delivery. Link responses can't be matched to orders with certainty.
templates.after-delivery.name: How is your order?
templates.after-delivery.one_liner: Ask how the product is once it has arrived, with a link in your own emails.
templates.after-delivery.q_condition.tex: Did it arrive in good condition?
templates.after-delivery.q_like.text: How do you like what you received?
templates.age-range.learn_1: Which age groups buy from you most.
templates.age-range.learn_2: How revenue splits across age groups.
templates.age-range.name: What's your age range?
templates.age-range.one_liner: Ask buyers their age range, to see which age groups buy from you.
templates.age-range.q_age.help: Optional. It helps us understand who shops with us.
templates.almost-left.learn_2: What would have made it easier.
templates.almost-left.name: What almost stopped you?
templates.almost-left.one_liner: Ask what nearly stopped buyers from ordering, so you can fix it for the next ones.
templates.almost-left.q_blocker.text: Did anything nearly stop you from ordering today?
templates.almost-left.q_easier.text: What would have made it easier?
templates.brand-presence.learn_1: Which channels keep you in front of buyers.
templates.brand-presence.name: Where do you see us most?
templates.brand-presence.one_liner: The places buyers keep running into you, beyond where they first found you.
templates.brand-presence.q_seen.text: Where do you see us most often? Choose up to 3.
templates.business-buyer.good_to_know: The app doesn't collect contact details. Use the customer's details on the order to get in touch.
templates.business-buyer.learn_1: Which orders are business or group buys.
templates.business-buyer.learn_2: Who is interested in bulk pricing.
templates.business-buyer.name: Are you buying for a business?
templates.business-buyer.one_liner: Ask whether the order is for a business, to spot buyers who may want bulk pricing.
templates.business-buyer.q_bulk_price.te: Would you like us to share bulk pricing with you?
templates.channel-compass.learn_1: Which channels your buyers mention most, with revenue.
templates.channel-compass.learn_2: Whether buyers decide fast or take weeks.
templates.channel-compass.name: How did you hear about us?
templates.channel-compass.one_liner: Ask buyers where they first heard of you and see which channels bring in your sales.
templates.channel-compass.q_channel.text: Where did you first hear about us?
templates.channel-compass.q_creator.text: Which creator or account was it?
templates.come-back-reasons.name: Why did you come back?
templates.come-back-reasons.one_liner: Ask returning buyers what brought them back.
templates.come-back-reasons.q_reason.tex: What brought you back today? Choose up to 2.
templates.contact-preference.good_to_kno: This records a preference only. It doesn't subscribe anyone to email or text messages; use your email or SMS app's own sign-up for consent.
templates.contact-preference.learn_1: Whether to put your effort into email, texts or social.
templates.contact-preference.learn_2: How many buyers want no marketing at all.
templates.contact-preference.name: How should we stay in touch?
templates.contact-preference.one_liner: The channels buyers want to hear from you on, so your messages get read.
I'd rather not hear from you
How would you like to hear from us? Choose up to 3.
templates.customer-satisfaction.learn_1: Your customer satisfaction (CSAT) score over time.
templates.customer-satisfaction.name: How satisfied are you? (CSAT)
templates.customer-satisfaction.one_line: The 1 to 5 satisfaction question, with a follow-up for buyers who were not happy.
templates.customer-satisfaction.q_better: What could we have done better?
templates.customer-satisfaction.q_csat.t: How satisfied are you with your order today?
templates.deciding-detail.learn_2: What buyers missed on the page.
templates.deciding-detail.name: What helped you decide?
templates.deciding-detail.one_liner: Ask which part of your product page helped buyers decide, and what was missing.
templates.deciding-detail.q_helped.text: Which part of the product page helped you decide most?
templates.deciding-detail.q_missing.text: Was anything missing that would have helped?
templates.delivery-promise.name: How fast do you need it?
templates.delivery-promise.one_liner: Ask how fast buyers expect their order and whether they need it by a date.
templates.delivery-promise.q_expectation: When are you expecting your order to arrive?
Do you need it by a specific date?
templates.delivery-ready.good_to_know_1: This doesn't cancel or change orders. It adds tags so your team can contact the buyer before shipping.
templates.delivery-ready.good_to_know_2: Payment targeting works on the Thank you page only.
templates.delivery-ready.learn_1: Which orders need a delivery check.
templates.delivery-ready.name: Will you be home for delivery?
templates.delivery-ready.one_liner: Ask whether buyers will be available to receive the order, before you ship.
Maybe, another day would be better
Will someone be available to receive this order?
templates.delivery-ready.q_delivery_time: When is the best time to deliver?
templates.delivery-ready.q_pay_online.he: Shown only when you target orders paid on delivery.
templates.delivery-ready.q_pay_online.te: Would you like to pay online next time?
templates.first-order-pulse.learn_1: How easy the first order felt.
templates.first-order-pulse.name: How was your first order?
templates.first-order-pulse.one_liner: Ask first-time buyers how ordering went and whether they'd order again.
templates.first-order-pulse.q_again.text: Would you order from us again?
templates.first-order-pulse.q_ease.text: How easy was it to order from us for the first time?
templates.fit-confidence.name: Are you sure about the size?
templates.fit-confidence.one_liner: Ask buyers how sure they are about size or fit, so you can help before shipping.
templates.fit-confidence.q_fit_sure.text: How sure are you about the size or fit you chose?
templates.gift-radar.name: Is this a gift?
templates.gift-radar.one_liner: Ask which orders are gifts, and for which occasion.
templates.loyalty-pulse.learn_1: Your Net Promoter Score over time.
templates.loyalty-pulse.learn_2: Why promoters and detractors feel that way.
templates.loyalty-pulse.name: Would you recommend us? (NPS)
templates.loyalty-pulse.one_liner: The 0 to 10 recommend score, with a follow-up asking why.
templates.loyalty-pulse.q_love.text: What do you love most about us?
templates.loyalty-pulse.q_nps.text: How likely are you to recommend us to a friend?
templates.missing-piece.name: What couldn't you find?
templates.missing-piece.one_liner: Ask what buyers looked for in your store but couldn't find.
templates.missing-piece.q_looked.text: Did you look for anything you couldn't find?
templates.nudge-counter.learn_1: How many touches new buyers need.
templates.nudge-counter.name: How many times did you see us?
templates.nudge-counter.one_liner: Ask how many times buyers saw your brand before they ordered, and where.
templates.nudge-counter.q_nudges.text: Before today, how many times had you seen or heard about us?
templates.nudge-counter.q_where.text: Where did you see us? Choose up to 3.
templates.offer-impact.learn_1: How many buyers would have bought without the discount.
templates.offer-impact.name: Did the discount matter?
templates.offer-impact.one_liner: Whether your offers win sales you would not get otherwise, or give away margin.
templates.offer-impact.q_offer.helped: It helped, but I'd have bought anyway
templates.offer-impact.q_offer.needed: Yes, I wouldn't have bought without it
templates.offer-impact.q_offer.no_offer: I didn't use a discount or offer
templates.offer-impact.q_offer.text: Did a discount or offer help you decide today?
templates.offer-impact.q_offer_where.cou: On a coupon or deals website
templates.offer-impact.q_offer_where.sms: In a text message from you
templates.offer-impact.q_offer_where.tex: Where did you find the offer?
templates.open-feedback.learn_1: Ideas, praise and problems in buyers' own words.
templates.open-feedback.learn_2: Topics worth turning into their own question later.
templates.open-feedback.name: Anything else to tell us?
templates.open-feedback.one_liner: One open question, for what your other questions never ask.
templates.open-feedback.q_anything.text: Is there anything else you'd like to tell us?
templates.packaging-priorities.name: What matters in packaging?
templates.packaging-priorities.one_liner: Ask what buyers want from your packaging, from less plastic to gift-ready.
templates.packaging-priorities.q_packagi: What matters most to you in packaging? Choose up to 2.
templates.price-pulse.learn_2: What would make a price feel worth it.
templates.price-pulse.name: How do our prices feel?
templates.price-pulse.one_liner: Ask buyers whether your prices feel fair.
templates.price-pulse.q_price.text: How did the price feel for what you bought?
templates.price-pulse.q_worth.more_quant: A bigger size or more quantity
templates.price-pulse.q_worth.text: What would make it feel worth it?
templates.product-discovery.learn_1: Whether your search and menus do their job.
templates.product-discovery.name: How did you find the product?
templates.product-discovery.one_liner: How buyers reached what they bought: search, menus, recommendations or a link.
templates.product-discovery.q_easy.text: How easy was it to find?
templates.product-discovery.q_found.dire: A link in an ad, email or post
templates.product-discovery.q_found.knew: I knew exactly what I wanted
templates.product-discovery.q_found.sear: With the search on your website
templates.product-discovery.q_found.text: How did you find the product you bought today?
templates.product-fit.learn_1: How many buyers would be very disappointed without you.
templates.product-fit.learn_2: What your most loyal buyers value, in their words.
templates.product-fit.name: Would you miss us? (product-market fit)
templates.product-fit.one_liner: Ask returning buyers how they'd feel if they could no longer buy from you, and why they buy.
templates.product-fit.q_miss.text: How would you feel if you could no longer buy from us?
templates.product-fit.q_why.text: What's the main reason you buy from us?
templates.purchase-reason.learn_1: The main reason buyers order from you.
templates.purchase-reason.learn_2: Which reasons bring in the most revenue.
templates.purchase-reason.name: What made you buy today?
templates.purchase-reason.one_liner: Ask for the main reason buyers ordered, so you know what to say in your ads and product pages.
templates.purchase-reason.q_detail.text: Anything else that helped you decide?
templates.purchase-reason.q_reason.price: A good price or a deal
templates.purchase-reason.q_reason.text: What was the main reason you bought today?
templates.reorder-clock.good_to_know: This app doesn't send reminders. Use the tag in your email or SMS tool, or in Shopify Flow.
templates.reorder-clock.learn_1: When buyers expect to run out.
templates.reorder-clock.name: When will you run out?
templates.reorder-clock.one_liner: Ask when buyers expect to run out, so reminders arrive at the right time.
templates.reorder-clock.q_lasts.text: How long do you think this will last you?
templates.reorder-clock.q_reorder_remind: Would a reminder when it's time to reorder be helpful?
templates.rival-check.learn_1: How often buyers shop around before choosing you.
templates.rival-check.learn_2: The rival names that come up most.
templates.rival-check.learn_3: What wins the sale against them.
templates.rival-check.name: Did you compare us?
templates.rival-check.one_liner: Which other brands buyers looked at, and what made them choose you.
templates.rival-check.q_brands.text: Which brands did you look at?
templates.rival-check.q_compared.text: Did you look at other brands before choosing us?
templates.site-ease.learn_1: How many buyers had trouble on your website.
templates.site-ease.learn_2: What exactly was hard to use, in their words.
templates.site-ease.name: Was anything hard to use?
templates.site-ease.one_liner: Ask buyers whether anything on your website was hard to use, and read what to fix.
templates.site-ease.q_hard.text: Was anything on our website hard to use today?
templates.site-ease.q_what.placeholder: For example: finding my size, the discount code, shipping costs
templates.subscribe-interest.learn_1: Whether a subscription offer is worth building.
templates.subscribe-interest.name: Would you subscribe?
templates.subscribe-interest.one_liner: How many buyers want automatic deliveries, and how often.
templates.subscribe-interest.q_subscribe: No, I'll order when I need it
Would you like this delivered automatically?
templates.switch-story.name: What did you use before us?
templates.switch-story.one_liner: Ask what buyers used before you and why they switched.
templates.switch-story.q_before.nothing_: Nothing, this is new for me
templates.switch-story.q_before.text: Before this, what did you use instead?
templates.switch-story.q_reason.text: What made you switch to us?
templates.taste-profile.learn_2: What buyers want to hear about.
templates.taste-profile.name: What are your preferences?
templates.taste-profile.one_liner: Ask about each buyer's preferences, like skin type or style, to personalise what you send.
templates.taste-profile.q_hear_about.tex: What would you like to hear about? Choose up to 3.
templates.today-trigger.learn_1: Which channel closes the sale, next to the one that starts it.
templates.today-trigger.learn_2: How many sales your emails, texts and ads bring back.
templates.today-trigger.name: What brought you here today?
templates.today-trigger.one_liner: The last thing that sent buyers to your store today, next to where they first heard of you.
templates.today-trigger.q_today.text: What brought you to our store today?
templates.today-trigger.q_today.typed_ad: I typed your address or used a bookmark
templates.trust-trigger.learn_2: Which proof to show more of.
templates.trust-trigger.name: What made you trust us?
templates.trust-trigger.one_liner: Ask first-time buyers what made them feel safe ordering from you.
templates.trust-trigger.q_trust.text: What made you trust us enough to order? Choose up to 2.
templates.where-else.learn_1: Which marketplaces and stores your buyers use.
templates.where-else.learn_2: How many buy only from you.
templates.where-else.name: Where else do you shop?
templates.where-else.one_liner: Whether your buyers also shop on Amazon, in physical stores or with other brands.
templates.where-else.q_where.marketplace: Other marketplaces, such as eBay or Etsy
templates.where-else.q_where.text: Where else do you buy products like this? Choose up to 3.
